key_points: Regulatory scrutiny on Alibaba's $1.5B Pupu investment and Ant Group stake valuation.
Pending class action lawsuit with lead plaintiff deadline Oct 5, 2026.
Notable insider selling by CFO, General Counsel, and other executives.
Continued AI and cloud expansion (ten-trillion-parameter plan) pressuring cash flow.
Stock down ~27% YTD with five consecutive earnings misses; analysts rate moderate buy.
